description: break-inside: avoid on flow blocks: a bordered box that does not fit the space left on the page starts on a fresh page instead of being cut by the page bottom. Covers a 220pt figure pushed to page 2, a 520pt chart pushed to a page of its own, and a block taller than a whole page, which still starts a fresh page and then breaks inside it (as Chrome does).
visual_assertions: Page 1 holds the two intro paragraphs and Figures One and Two; the space left below Figure Two is blank because Figure Three would not fit there whole.
Figure Three prints whole at the top of page 2, and the 520pt Chart Four prints whole at the top of page 3 — no bordered box is ever cut by a page boundary.
The Too Long block is taller than one page: it starts at the top of page 4 and breaks inside, continuing onto page 5.
